items.title: Molineux monitored, Hamilton out of ODIs, Brown out with back injury
items.summary: Molineux is battling a hip injury but has been named to face Bangladesh and New Zealand while Hamilton is out of the ODIs with a minor quad strain

items.title: Salahuddin, Ashraful reunite at Fortune in D3
items.summary: Former Bangladesh national team senior assistant coach Mohammad Salahuddin was picked as Fortune’s head coach, with current national team batting coach Mohammad Ashraful and Abdul Karim Juel picked as his assistants during the inaugural team management draft for the upcoming D3 competition in Mirpur yesterday.

items.title: Pakistan meet Bangladesh, India meet Sri Lanka in Asian Games men's semi-finals
items.summary: All four semi-finalists are yet to contest a ball in the tournament so far

items.title: Bangladesh to take on Pakistan in semis after another washout
items.summary: Bangladesh went through because of their higher seeding compared to Malaysia

items.title: Asian Games Cricket: Bangladesh, Sri Lanka reach semifinals without playing a ball
items.summary: The Sri Lankans will meet India in the last four and Bangladesh play Pakistan, with both matches scheduled for Thursday.

items.title: Najmul Hossain Shanto ruled out of Asian Games due to illness
items.summary: He has been suffering from fever since his arrival in Nagoya for men's cricket competition

items.title: ‎ Shanto ruled out of Asian Games with fever
items.summary: Bangladesh will face Malaysia in their quarterfinal on Tuesday. If the match is washed out due to rain, as Monday's two quarterfinals were, Bangladesh will advance to the semifinals without playing and face Pakistan on October 1.

items.title: Malaysia face Bangladesh in Asian Games quarter-final repeat from 2023
items.summary: The last time these two teams met, Malaysia fell just two runs short

items.title: Rain the decider in Asian Games cricket
items.summary: Sri Lanka play Nepal and Bangladesh face Malaysia, weather permitting, in the last two quarterfinals on Tuesday.

items.title: Molineux a doubt for Bangladesh ODIs with hip injury

items.summary: Quarter-final line-ups: Afghanistan vs India, Hong Kong vs Pakistan, Bangladesh vs Malaysia and Nepal vs Sri Lanka
